info.title: XSchematron.Cli
info.description: Command-line tool that validates an XML document against one or more ISO Schematron rule files, built on the XSchematron library.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Validates XML documents against ISO Schematron rule sets.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate an XML document against one or more Schematron rule files.

options.name: --schema
options.description: A Schematron (.sch) file to validate against. Repeat to use several.

options.name: --schema-dir
options.description: Directory of .sch files to validate against.

options.name: --phase
options.description: Run only the patterns activated by this phase id. Defaults to all patterns.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text or json. [default: text]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the report to this file instead of stdout.

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Lowest severity that causes a non-zero exit code: error, warning, or info. [default: error]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Print only the summary line, not individual messages. [default: False]
